kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
أحتجب (form VIII)
# أَحْتَجِبُ (ʔaḥtajibu) /ʔaħ.ta.d͡ʒi.bu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِحْتَجَبَ (iḥtajaba)
# أَحْتَجِبَ (ʔaḥtajiba) /ʔaħ.ta.d͡ʒi.ba/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِحْتَجَبَ (iḥtajaba)
# أَحْتَجِبْ (ʔaḥtajib) /ʔaħ.ta.d͡ʒib/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِحْتَجَبَ (iḥtajaba)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
